notes.title: Star Waker Release!
notes.notes:
Hello!

We're happy to have released Star Waker today, and we hope you'll have fun playing it!

If you downloaded it in the first few minutes of its release, know that there was a slight issue with the game, and you may have to close Steam and re-open it again in order to download the full game; it should weighs more than 300Mb.

Sorry for the inconvenience, and have fun everyone!
